name: Tokimori Nozomi
source: [url=/c14884]Kanae's[/url] younger sister who studied abroad, graduated college and became his class's teacher. She also serves as the Charity Club's adviser. In the public eye she appears as a strict teacher, but at home she acts like a spoiled little sister who loves her brother.
